- **`push`** — rejects when full (`count_ == cap_`), otherwise writes at `(head_ + count_) % cap_` and increments `count_`
- **`pop`** — rejects when empty, reads from `head_`, advances `head_` with wraparound, decrements `count_`
- **`size`** — returns `count_`
- **`empty`** — returns `count_ == 0`

All FIFO ordering, full/empty guards, and wraparound verified with a test harness.
